cards.question: How many customers do we have?
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM sales.customer

cards.question: Compare sales by territory, 2023 vs 2024.
cards.sql: SELECT t.name AS territory, sum(h.totaldue) FILTER (WHERE h.orderdate >= '2023-01-01' AND h.orderdate < '2024-01-01') AS revenue_2023, sum(h.totaldue) FILTER (WHERE h.orderdate >= '2024-01-01' AND h.orderdate < '2025-01-01') AS revenue_2024 FROM sales.salesorderheader h JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = h.territoryid WHERE h.orderdate >= '2023-01-01' AND h.orderdate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

cards.question: Which 5 salespeople had the highest sales in 2024?
cards.sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, sum(h.subtotal) AS sales FROM sales.salesorderheader h JOIN sales.salesperson s ON s.businessentityid = h.salespersonid JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = s.businessentityid WHERE h.orderdate >= '2024-01-01' AND h.orderdate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.businessentityid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5

cards.question: How did sales change between the two periods?
cards.followUpSql: SELECT sum(subtotal) FILTER (WHERE orderdate >= '2023-01-01' AND orderdate < '2024-01-01') AS revenue_2023, sum(subtotal) FILTER (WHERE orderdate >= '2024-01-01' AND orderdate < '2025-01-01') AS revenue_2024 FROM sales.salesorderheader

cards.question: Which 10 pairs of products are most often bought together in the same order? Show both product names and how often.
cards.sql: SELECT p1.name AS product_1, p2.name AS product_2, count(*) AS times_bought_together FROM sales.salesorderdetail a JOIN sales.salesorderdetail b ON a.salesorderid = b.salesorderid AND a.productid < b.productid JOIN production.product p1 ON p1.productid = a.productid JOIN production.product p2 ON p2.productid = b.productid GROUP BY p1.name, p2.name ORDER BY times_bought_together DESC LIMIT 10
